en: A vintage postcard featuring a detailed black-and-white illustration of an ornate building with towers and domes, labeled 'Tonhalle' at the bottom. The word 'Zürich' appears in the lower left, indicating the city. The card has handwritten text in German along the borders and within a dedicated space on the right side. The building is surrounded by a fence and trees, with a few people and a cyclist visible in the foreground.
